title: Lutos, no irrigation, Transylvanian plateau, mid-September
rationale: Lutos is suitable for every candidate, so grau_toamna is asserted into the top on soil suitability plus its 'zona colinară, nordul țării' window 09-25 → 10-05. rapita_toamna is excluded on the calendar: its Transylvania window ('restul țării (Transilvania, Moldova, nord)') is 08-25 → 09-05 and closed eight days before the case date, and the only window still open on 2026-09-13 is the southern one (09-05 → 09-15). Turda's day-0 tMax of 17.3 °C sits inside rapița's optimal_growth_c 15-22, so the exclusion rests on the sowing calendar alone, not on temperature.
